newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh Bank 90-day T-bill yield falls at 6.9p.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh Bank 90-day T-bill yield falls at 6.9p.

text.p: Bangladesh Bank, the country's central bank, sold 90-day treasury bills worth 150 million taka with a corresponding yield of 6.9 percent against 6.94 percent previously at an auction on Monday, a bank statement said.
The weighted average price against the bills was 98.31 taka per 100 taka against previous 98.29 taka.

The bank also sold 30-day treasury bills worth 430 million taka with a yield at 6.79 percent against 6.76 percent previously. The weighted average price was 99.44 taka per 100 taka, unchanged from previous level.
